description.value: Finest At Sea Ocean Products Ltd. is a Victoria institution operating since 1977, combining a boutique-style seafood market with an on-site fish and chip food truck steps from Fisherman's Wharf in James Bay. The company owns ten offshore fishing vessels — including the FV Ocean Pearl, described as the largest vessel in the BC fishing fleet — and sells 100% wild-caught BC seafood direct from their own fishermen. Touring cyclists can grab freshly cooked fish and chips from the food truck or pick up smoked salmon, candied sablefish, and live spot prawns from the market.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Finest At Sea operates a boutique seafood market and an on-site fish and chip food truck at 27 Erie Street in Victoria's James Bay neighborhood, directly across from Fisherman's Wharf. Phone (250) 383-7760 and address match OSM. The website contains no mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or most optional amenities, so those remain null; takeout is confirmed as the primary service mode of both the food truck and the market.
concerns: OSM cuisine tags list 'burger' and 'taco' but the website only confirms fish and chips for the food truck; the menu subpage contains no item detail beyond 'BEST FISH & CHIPS IN TOWN'. OSM cuisine tags may be inaccurate.
Website states the online shop is temporarily closed due to a values disagreement with Shopify; physical market and food truck locations remain open.
OSM address omits postal code; website confirms full address as 27 Erie Street, Victoria, BC V8V 1P8.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established Victoria seafood market and food truck directly across from Fisherman's Wharf — a heavily trafficked cycling destination. Clear value for touring cyclists seeking a quality, locally sourced food stop on Victoria's waterfront.
enrichment_extras.notes: Business operates two locations: the main James Bay seafood market and food truck at 27 Erie St, and a smaller satellite market at Langford Station (720 Station Ave, Langford). This listing covers the James Bay location only.
